why_it_fails: merging a pull request needs no one person's machine: an agent with the repository's access does it itself

input.title: Merge the docs change
input.brief:
1. Open https://github.com/example-org/app/pull/12
2. Press Squash and merge.
3. Press Confirm squash and merge.
input.check: gh pr view 12 --repo example-org/app --json state --jq .state | grep -qx MERGED
